title: 第9章 沈春的提点第10章 做人的差距咋就那么大捏
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 大长老和其他长老没有去夸赞楚星河，因为他们知道，楚星河这个好孩子不需要夸赞，他的行为已经告诉了所有人他是一个什么样的人。
大长老带着一群长老满脸笑意的离开了，药王宫虽然被毁掉，不过昊天宗的实力何等雄厚，本来因为药王宫弟子越来越多，就有些拥挤了。
现在被一把火烧了，反而可以建造一座更加宏伟的药王宫，所以这把火楚星河烧的好啊！
傍晚时分，一身脏兮兮的楚星河跟诸位灵鹤宫的师兄们完成了一天的工作，累是累了点，不过听到传闻说楚承又被人收拾了，这让楚星河一天的疲惫一扫而空。
要不是因为不合适，自己高低得去外门看看楚承到底被收拾成什么鬼样子了。
这边正准备跟冯飞回去休息，沈春却走了过来。
“星河师弟！”
“沈春师兄好！”
“哈哈……星河师弟你这一天忙里忙外的可是累得够呛啊，回去以后把你身上的核心弟子服脱下来交给门内弟子，会有专门的弟子帮你清洗的，这可是核心弟子才有的待遇啊。”
“那怎么行……沈春师兄不要再说了！”
楚星河一脸郑重道：“我入门最晚，怎能让师兄们为我洗衣服？我不能帮诸位师兄洗衣服已经是有些愧疚了，所以这衣服我自己洗，其他核心弟子什么待遇我不知道，但还请师兄不要再说了，就把我当成一个普通弟子对待，师兄们对我已经无比照顾了，我心中感恩诸位师兄。”
沈春泪目了……
还得是星河师弟啊……
就按照星河师弟所言，哦对了，星河师弟，再过几日就是灵冢开启的时间了，我已经安排人为师弟打听过了灵冢各处的信息，不知星河师弟喜欢什么样的灵兵？”
楚星河一愣，自己喜欢什么样的灵兵？
要知道，一般进入灵冢都是看运气的，昊天宗认为灵兵跟弟子相遇是有缘分的，本命灵兵会跟随弟子一生直至死亡那天才会重新返回灵冢之中，所以缘分很重要。
这个缘分呢，怎么说呢，就很玄妙。
有的人天赋极好，可是就因为进入灵冢一个不小心选择了最差的灵兵，结果缘分是来了，未来没了。
而有的人得到一把强力的灵兵，则可能为自己逆天改命。
但极少数人知道，所谓的缘分其实也不是绝对的，进入灵冢的都是新入门的弟子，对灵冢的情况也不了解。
哪怕一些被长老看重的弟子，进入灵冢之前可能得到一些小道消息，但长老们也不敢说太多，毕竟门规摆在那里呢。
可现在……沈春的意思，自己的缘分可以自己选？
“沈春师兄，这样做会不会违背门规？”
楚星河十分郑重的开口。
“不会……此事我悄悄探过大长老的口风，大长老那边也点头了……所以不会违背门规，不会受罚的，师弟你放心吧！”
我放心个锤子！
听完沈春的话，楚星河都气笑了，我问会不会违背门规是这个意思吗？
不违背门规那还有什么意思？不被处罚还有什么前途可言？
“这样啊，那就谢谢沈春师兄了，我喜欢贱……咳咳……剑！”
content_en:
The First Elder and other elders did not praise Chu Xinghe because they knew that Chu Xinghe, a good boy, did not need praise. His actions had already told everyone what kind of person he was.
The great elder left with a group of elders with smiles on their faces. Although the Yaowang Palace was destroyed, the Haotian Sect was so powerful. Originally, because there were more and more disciples in the Yaowang Palace, it was a bit crowded.
Now that it is burned by a fire, a more magnificent Yaowang Palace can be built, so this fire Chu Xinghe is burned well!
In the evening, Chu Xinghe, who was all dirty and dirty, had finished the day's work with the senior brothers from Linghe Palace. He was a little tired. However, he heard rumors that Chu Cheng was taken care of again, which made Chu Xinghe's day's fatigue disappear.
If it weren't for the inappropriateness, I would have gone to the outer gate to see what kind of mess Chu Cheng was being treated in.
Just as he was about to go back to rest with Feng Fei, Shen Chun came over.
"Junior Brother Xinghe!"
"Hello, Senior Brother Chen Chun!"
"Haha... Junior Brother Xinghe, you are very tired from your busy schedule this day. When you get back, take off your core disciple uniform and give it to the disciples. There will be dedicated disciples to help you clean it. This is a treatment only core disciples have."
"How can that be done...Senior Brother Chen Chun, please stop talking!"
Chu Xinghe said solemnly: "I am the latest to join, how can I ask my senior brothers to wash my clothes? I feel guilty that I cannot help you wash your clothes, so I wash the clothes myself. I don't know how the other core disciples are treated, but please stop talking and treat me as an ordinary disciple. The senior brothers have taken great care of me. I am grateful to you all in my heart."
Shen Chun burst into tears...
It has to be Junior Brother Xinghe...
"Okay!
According to what Junior Brother Xinghe said, oh by the way, Junior Brother Xinghe, in a few days it will be the time for the tomb to be opened. I have arranged for someone to inquire about the information about the tomb. I wonder what kind of spiritual soldiers Junior Brother Xinghe likes? "
"Ah..."
Chu Xinghe was stunned, what kind of spiritual soldier did he like?
You know, generally entering the spiritual tomb depends on luck. Haotian Sect believes that the encounter between the spiritual soldier and the disciple is fate. The destined spiritual soldier will follow the disciple for life until the day of death before returning to the spiritual tomb, so fate is very important.
This fate, how should I put it, is very mysterious.
Some people are very talented, but just because they entered the spiritual tomb, they accidentally chose the worst spiritual soldier. As a result, fate came and their future was gone.
And some people who get a powerful spiritual weapon may change their destiny against the will of heaven.
But very few people know that the so-called fate is not absolute. Those who enter the spiritual tomb are all new disciples and do not understand the situation of the spiritual tomb.
Even if some disciples who are valued by the elders may get some gossip before entering the spiritual tomb, the elders dare not say too much, after all, the sect rules are there.
But now... Chen Chun means that you can choose your own fate?
"Senior Brother Chen Chun, will doing this violate the sect rules?"
Chu Xinghe spoke very solemnly.
"No... I quietly asked the Great Elder about this matter, and the Great Elder also nodded... So I won't violate the sect rules, and I won't be punished. Junior brother, don't worry!"
I'm relieved!
After hearing what Chen Chun said, Chu Xinghe laughed angrily. I asked if he would violate the sect rules. Is that what he meant?
If it doesn't violate the rules, what's the point? What future is there without being punished?
"That's it, then thank you, Senior Brother Chen Chun. I like cheap...ahem...swords!"
title_en: Chapter 9 Chen Chun’s Tips Chapter 10 Why are the differences between people so big?
